title: Get Saved Result Set Data
description: Returns the data published to the Saved Result Set using rules.

query.name: version
query.description: Pass the Saved Result Set version.

enumValue.description: Retrieves the data that is published using the Save Result Set action in rules. Saved Result Set v2 retrieves indicator and vulnerability data only.
Retrieves the data that is published using the Save Result Set V3 action in rules.

query.name: label_name
query.description: Pass a tag name to filter data. All data associated the passed tag will be returned.

query.name: from_timestamp
query.description: Pass the published time in epoch format from which you want to retrieve data.

query.name: to_timestamp
query.description: Pass the published time in epoch format until which you want to retrieve data.

query.name: page
query.description: Pass the page number to retrieve records.

query.name: page_size
query.description: Pass the number of records to retrieve on each page.

body.name: next
body.description: Returns a link to the next page.

body.name: previous
body.description: Returns a link to the previous page.

body.name: page_size
body.description: Returns the number of records retrieved per page.

body.name: total
body.description: Returns the total number of records available in the Saved Result Set.

body.name: results
body.description: Returns the list of Saved Result Set data.
